detailed_description: Etsy Fee Calculator estimates total fees, net revenue, profit, and margin from editable Etsy-style fee assumptions. Enter sale price, shipping charge, item cost, shipping cost, listing fee, transaction rate, payment rate, fixed fee, offsite ads rate, and currency to model pricing before you compare it with current marketplace rules.
usage_steps: Enter the item sale price, shipping charge, item cost, and shipping cost.
Set the listing fee, transaction rate, payment rate, fixed fee, and offsite ads rate you want to model.
Review gross revenue, total fees, net revenue, estimated profit, and profit margin.
Compare the assumptions with your real seller account, region, taxes, and current marketplace fee schedule before pricing.
usage_examples: Check whether a handmade product still has margin after item cost, shipping cost, and processing assumptions.
Compare the effect of changing shipping charge or offsite ads percentage on estimated profit.
Model a new listing price before updating your shop spreadsheet or seller notes.

faqs.question: Is Etsy Fee Calculator free?
faqs.answer: Yes. Etsy Fee Calculator runs free in your browser and does not require an account.

faqs.question: Are these official current Etsy rates?
faqs.answer: No. The calculator uses editable Etsy-style fee assumptions. Check Etsy's current fee schedule and your seller account before making pricing decisions.

faqs.question: What costs should I include?
faqs.answer: Include item cost and shipping cost separately so the profit estimate reflects both product production and fulfillment assumptions.

faqs.question: Does it include taxes or every seller-specific charge?
faqs.answer: No. It is a planning calculator for common fee and cost inputs, not tax, accounting, or platform policy advice.
